scope: All 36 actual outputs and traces were read. Prior judgments were reused only for unchanged core answers after equality checks. Additional answers and the changed Thai reply were semantically reviewed; no regex-only correctness grading.

summary.meaning: Two repeat attempts of 18 synthetic scenarios, not 36 independent tasks or a production reliability estimate.
roundDifferences: public-services-th: round 1 pass, round 2 fail because order-tracking wording becomes malformed. Other final answers match between rounds.
summary.promotionConclusion: Core limitations remain: no executable tools, unsupported action promises, missed evidence/history and incomplete recovery guidance. No production promotion.
summary.humanValidationRemaining: Native Thai and other semantic judgments remain subject to human validation before promotion.

cases.answerReviewed:
The total cost before discount is:  
(7 * 45) + (3 * 18) = 315 + 54 = 369 THB  

Apply a 10% discount:  
369 - (369 * 0.10) = 369 - 36.9 = 332.1 THB  

Add 25 THB shipping:  
332.1 + 25 = 357.1 THB  

Total: 357.1 THB

measurementReview.firstCase: The final baseline was reported as warmed by the runner operator. Review timing from this artifact rather than the earlier cold-ish 12-case sample.
measurementReview.cpu: CPU seconds and utilization cover first-to-last in-case sample windows, not full wall time. Process set changes and concurrent inference can contaminate aggregate values; do not present as whole-machine utilization.
measurementReview.memory: Sampled inference-process working set excludes operating system, Studio, browser and Node. It is not an exact machine peak.
measurementReview.repetition: A fixed seed and two rounds do not guarantee bitwise deterministic output or establish reliable production failure probabilities. The Thai answer changed between rounds.
